rules.official_behavior: The alert neither clears nor blocks the value; Validate repeats the check.

rules.condition: Month, day, or year is blank.
rules.rejected_behavior: The active operation stops unless official_behavior states otherwise.

rules.condition: Return period is an impossible calendar date such as February 31.
rules.rejected_behavior: The active operation stops unless official_behavior states otherwise.
rules.official_behavior: Only component comparisons against today run; calendar validity is never checked.
rules.recommended_app_behavior: Validate the composed calendar date.

rules.condition: Line of business is blank.

rules.condition: Schedule 2 rows are incomplete.
